News News Detail Start of main content Navy Region Mid-Atlantic installations shift to FPCON Charlie 14 February 2023 From CNRMA Public Affairs Today at approximately 2:10 p.m., Commander, Navy Region Mid-Atlantic ordered Navy installations across the Region to increase to Force Protection Level (FPCON) Charlie. Share PRINT RSS Tags CNRMA NS Norfolk JEB Little Creek-Fort Story NAS Oceana NSA Hampton Roads NNSY Solid Curtain Today at approximately 2:10 p.m., Commander, Navy Region Mid-Atlantic ordered Navy installations across the Region to increase to Force Protection Level (FPCON) Charlie. The order issued by Rear Adm. Scott Gray, Commander, Navy Region Mid-Atlantic, is in support of Solid Curtain 2023 training exercise and not in response to any specific threat. Increased FPCON levels may impact access to Navy installations. Solid Curtain 2023 exercise will continue through Friday.
